notes: Inline text link. Label renders through Text atom for typography — any Text prop can be forwarded via 'text'. For links that need visual weight (glass, pill, padding), use Button with href instead. All 4 renders use the same Link.astro — pipeline strips animation props in reduced/assistive/textonly. Textonly render: all links become plain underlined text (colour overrides, weight, uppercase all reset). Click + keyboard handling is native <a href> + global focus-system.

contentLink.description: Link text. Pipeline content key. Renders through the Text atom.

external.description: External link — adds target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer.

text._description: Text atom props for the label — spread onto the nested Text. Accepts any Text prop (family, size, weight, leading, etc). Link locks 'as=span' and 'flush' internally.

textStyle._description: Forwarded to the Text atom. See Text.schema.json for the full prop list.

variant.description: Visual indicator style. default=colour only, underline=static underline, highlight=subtle background, border=thin border, ghost=subtle colour.

color.description: Colour variant — sets link colour tokens. 'text' = body text scale (always readable).

disabled.description: Disabled state — strikethrough, not-allowed cursor, no hover/click/focus, no highlight-links outline. Sets aria-disabled=true and tabindex=-1.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — stripped in reduced/assistive/textonly renders

underlineGrow.description: Underline scales from left on hover. Requires variant=underline for static fallback.

highlightGrow.description: Background highlight grows from bar to full coverage on hover. Requires variant=highlight for static fallback.

shadowFill.description: Box-shadow inset fills from left on hover. Works with any variant.

textSlide.description: Text colour sweeps from left via background-clip, with coordinated underline grow.
